sources.note: Not about Chepya: describes the sister Hanoid language Wanyeu (Muchi) as a three-tone language (high 55, mid 33, low 21) with no mention of stress. Mentions 'Chipia (Akha)' only as one of the 15/18 officially recognised Akha subgroups of Laos (pp. 23-24). Its reference list shows that Shintani, Kosaka & Kato (eds.) 2001 consists of per-language sketches based on ~300-item wordlists (e.g. 'Wanyä (Muchi)', pp. 192-212).
